build_regnet_model_from_config: build a RegNet model from a config dict using RegNet.from_config with depth, w_0, w_a, w_m, and group_width parameters
create_regnetparams_and_expand: create a RegNetParams object then call get_expanded_params to compute per-stage widths, strides, depths, and group widths
instantiate_regnet_y_variant: instantiate a RegNetY variant like RegNetY400mf or RegNetY8gf with optional keyword arguments to override default settings
instantiate_regnet_x_variant: instantiate a RegNetX variant like RegNetX400mf or RegNetX32gf with Squeeze-and-Excitation disabled for lightweight models
run_regnet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a RegNet model by calling forward with an input tensor to get trunk output features
